title: NWEA MAP — Achievement vs. Growth
skills: distinguish academic achievement from academic growth
interpret progress in relation to starting point and performance level
reflect on learning gains using assessment information
use achievement and growth data to support goal setting and self-evaluation
alignment_note: Explains the difference between achievement and growth using NWEA MAP assessment concepts. Supports assessment literacy, student reflection, goal setting, metacognition, and interpretation of academic progress across high school English courses and advisory contexts.
